sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The spring campaign came in {MONEY} under budget with more leads than planned.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sorry, {MONEY}, was it?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to put that money into the summer campaign.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Approved, carry it over to summer.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, thank you.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: How did spring go?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We were {MONEY} under budget and beat the lead target.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Did you say {MONEY}?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to roll that into summer.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes, move it to the summer campaign.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We need a decision on the rebrand.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Customer testing preferred the new logo by a small margin.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: A small margin isn't much to go on for a rebrand.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We keep the current logo and only refresh the colours and fonts.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, that's simpler too.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What did testing say about the logo?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The new one won, but only narrowly.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Too close to justify it, so the logo stays and we just update colours and fonts.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Understood.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The events budget question.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Last year's three big events produced {PERCENT} of our qualified leads.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And they cost a lot.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Keep the two best events and drop the third.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Got it, {S2}, thanks.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'd have picked the same.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The three big events brought in {PERCENT} of qualified leads last year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: At a high cost, though.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Cut it to the two best-performing events.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Sorry, {S2}, could you repeat that?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Makes sense.
